name: Jezebel
bio: Jezebel was the daughter of Ethbaal, king of the Sidonians, whom Ahab, king of Israel, married — a union Scripture treats as the decisive turn of his reign toward unprecedented evil. Through this marriage Ahab began to serve and worship Baal himself, building a temple and altar for Baal in Samaria and making an Asherah pole, provoking the LORD to anger more than any king of Israel before him (1 Kings 16:31-33). Jezebel's own active role in promoting Baal worship, her clashes with the prophet Elijah, and her lasting infamy are told in detail in the chapters ahead.
